name: Righteous Fire Chieftain
summary: Righteous Fire on the Chieftain shell: a fire aura that burns enemies while you walk, backed by armour, life regeneration and fire resistance. Low APM, very forgiving, and no required unique. A Dad build by design.

pros.text: Righteous Fire burns while you move; very low APM.
Chieftain life regeneration and armour make mistakes forgiving.
No required unique; life, armour and fire resistance are the gear.
A good Dad build: simple rotation and a clear defensive layer.
The fire aura clears packs without aiming.
The same strength armour bases as the melee builds.

cons.text: Righteous Fire burns your own life; the regeneration has to keep up.
Single-target damage is lower than a dedicated hit build.
Clear speed is slower than a bow build.
Fire resistance and life are hard requirements, not upgrades.
The build wants a six-link for its best damage.
It is a poor choice for no-regeneration maps.

pantheon.note: Gruthkul reduces physical damage taken, which is most of what kills a low-APM build.

notes: First guide for the Covens league.

Armour and life regeneration are the defence, not block.
A 5-link clears white maps; start the 6-link.
Reach 3,000 life, cap resistances and keep armour.
Six-link, 20% quality gems, 4,500 life and 6,000 max hit.
Maximum fire resistance and armour are the red-map upgrades.
Cap chaos resistance at 75% and reach 5,000 life.
Use 21/20 Righteous Fire and awakened burning supports.

summary.text: Righteous Fire Chieftain is a low-APM fire aura build that measures 27.1k at red maps and 46.5k at pinnacle. Life regeneration and armour carry the defence, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Rolling Magma, then switch to Righteous Fire when your life regeneration can carry it. The first checkpoint measures 445 life and 29 damage; the second measures 747.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 27.1k damage, 21647 effective life and 9385 physical max hit. Keep fire resistance and life above the breakpoints and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 46.5k damage with 32745 effective life and 11338 physical max hit. Keep the fire aura on the boss and move through the small hits; avoid no-regeneration maps.
